verdicts.summary: Kept, renamed honestly, model made CONDITIONAL. On today's record the lowest rung that clears is deterministic software: a diff, a date calculation under a published rule, a fixed template and a release button. Week one is a FORMAT FINDING at one hub, and if the reconciliation is a Takeflite report or export the extraction model is deleted from scope, making the build cheaper AND more reliable. Consignee matching uses deterministic fuzzy matching with a human queue below threshold, never an LLM. Pilot at BETHEL, not Aniak or Nome.
verdicts.cost_of_error: The notice is not a courtesy message, it is a billing instrument. A wrong notice starts a fee clock the customer did not earn and becomes a billing dispute with a written record Ryan Air created. Moffatt v. Air Canada is directly on point. False positive and false negative are NOT symmetric, a missed notice is the status quo, a wrong notice costs money and trust, so the matrix is tuned hard toward suppress-and-queue and never toward send. The reviewer holds genuine ground truth because they physically handled that freight that day. Guardrails: capped batch size, only the diff and low-confidence lines need explicit action, override rate tracked live as the rubber-stamp detector, NO storage fee may ever be raised on a flagged or corrected line, and a retraction path ships in version one.
verdicts.data_readiness: THIS IS THE PROJECT, not a footnote. Four gaps. (1) The FORMAT of the daily reconciliation is unknown, and the only evidence is one sentence in one Bethel job posting sitting beside another line saying received freight is input into TakeFlite, which cuts toward the data already being digital. (2) CONSIGNEE CONTACT DETAILS are unestablished, and all eight stations publishing a fax hints today's written notification may be paper or fax. If that data is missing, phase one is contact capture, a DATA project not an AI project. (3) Takeflite access is unverified, which is why this build stays read-only with the notice log in our own store. (4) No baseline exists, so week one is measurement. Consignee names and shipment references are PII in very small communities, so a mis-sent notice is a privacy event as well as a billing one.
verdicts.step_math: Ten steps, seven deterministic and exhaustively testable at roughly 99.9 percent each, so the deterministic chain runs about 99.1 percent end to end with detectable, retryable residual failures. Only the parse is probabilistic, and only if the input is unstructured. If the reconciliation is machine readable the pipeline is deterministic and the accuracy ceiling is the physical count itself. If handwritten at 90 percent per line with a reviewer catching 90 percent of slips, customer-visible error lands near 1.1 percent of lines, which is not good enough for a document that starts a billing clock. No extraction accuracy may be promised before real sample sheets are in hand.

verdicts.summary: Reduced from a twelve week build to a TWO WEEK ACCESS SPIKE whose only deliverable is a written yes or no on API access, event schema and contract terms, with a go or no-go attached. Nobody prices or promises the engine before that answer exists. Also stop calling it an AI candidate, it contains no model of any kind, and selling it under an AI heading is the agent washing Gartner names.
verdicts.cost_of_error: Same billing and Moffatt exposure as the desk with the one control removed. No station step means no human holds ground truth before a fee-starting message goes out, so an event firing on a scan rather than physical arrival sends a notice for freight nobody has seen. That is a WORSE risk profile, not a better one, which is the honest inversion of its higher RICE impact.

verdicts.summary: Downscoped from a four person-week build to ONE SUPPORT TICKET first. Tell them to ask Takeflite whether the Bypass Mail Order field can be enabled, because Everts exposes it on the same platform, so configuration is the likely answer. If it is a setting, nobody should be paid for it, including us. We say that out loud even though it removes billable work, because being the shop that tells them the cheap answer is the entire reason the rest of the study gets read. Zero AI either way.
verdicts.cost_of_error: Low on the read side. One real risk, partitioning. A public tracker keyed on a number could surface a shipment Ryan Air handled for Everts at Aniak or Nome. Row-level access control keyed to the consignee on the airbill is mandatory from day one.

verdicts.summary: Killed on the record, on our own reasoning rather than deference to its 0.13 score. The ladder settles it before liability even enters: every intent decomposes to a lookup or to arithmetic, both of which deterministic software does at effectively 100 percent, testable, explainable and cheaper, so Rule 1 of Rules of ML applies at full strength and there is no unique thing AI does here. As specified it is not an agent, it is a chatbot with a database lookup and an escalation path, and calling it agentic is agent washing. Cost of delay is genuinely NEGATIVE, waiting improves it.
verdicts.cost_of_error: Disqualifying on its own. All three intents are money statements. A rate quote is six interacting modifiers and a wrong one is a misquote the carrier owns. An arrival status answer starts the storage clock in a conversation with no reviewable record. A refund answer is a promise against a published ten business day window. Nobody catches any of it, there is no reviewer inside a live call, which is exactly the condition AI_SCOPING says means do not use AI or wrap it in human review, and a live call can't carry review without defeating the point. Google PAIR names four wrong-fit conditions and this hits three. Brand cost is specific: eight stations serving 70 to 80 villages under a tagline about serving friends and family for over 70 years, where the phone IS the relationship and one bad interaction travels the whole community.
verdicts.step_math: Seven model-dependent steps per call. At 95 percent per step about 70 percent full-call success, at the 85 to 90 percent real systems hit about 48 percent. Roughly half to two thirds of calls fully right, with no checkpoint, against a human agent who is already correct and already standing next to the freight.
verdicts.reopen_condition: A measured call log showing a large single-intent residue AFTER the deterministic work ships, at which point a narrow non-committal deflection on one intent could be scoped with a real baseline. Nothing in today's record gets close.

verdicts.summary: Keep in the Next lane, labelled in the study as containing ZERO AI, since that label is the point rather than a caveat. Best data readiness on the board and it is not close, the entire rule set is published verbatim with no model, no third-party dependency, no labeling and no corpus. Guardrails: the NAC-style disclaimer their sibling already publishes, and rate-table drift, the calculator must read from one maintained table and print the effective date on every quote. One dependency on the free work, an estimate can't say when freight moves because no cutoff is published.
verdicts.honest_flag: Sibling Northern Air Cargo already runs a self-serve estimator across sixteen cargo categories inside the same Saltchuk Aviation family, so the cheapest path may be reuse from a sibling or shared services rather than a build from us, and the study should say that before they discover it themselves.

verdicts.summary: Downscoped to the Later lane and dropped a rung. It is squeezed from both sides, which is the finding: the high-frequency agent questions are either arithmetic, which belongs to the quote engine, or policy that is not written down anywhere, which belongs to the free publishing work. What is left is thin enough that the first honest version is a maintained internal reference page with search, NOT retrieval. Promotion trigger is explicit, log agent questions for a month after the policies are published, and if the logs show real natural-language variety keyword search misses, retrieval has earned its rung and we build it with an eval set drawn from those logs.
verdicts.cost_of_error: Internal-only reduces Moffatt exposure, it does not remove it. The user is a cross-trained agent with a customer on the phone, so a wrong internal answer becomes an external statement one sentence later, the liability is laundered rather than eliminated. Answers must be extractive with a citation to the tariff line and must say 'not stated' when the corpus is silent.

verdicts.summary: Keep, LEAD WITH IT, charge nothing. RICE arithmetic confirmed, 9 reach times 1.0 impact times 0.90 confidence over 0.5 person-weeks is 16.2 against 2.08 for the pick. It goes IN FRONT of the paid work rather than behind it.
verdicts.correction: The half week is the PUBLISHING effort, NOT the DECISION effort. Setting a freight cutoff across eight stations and signing off a claims procedure and an embargo policy are operational and possibly group-level legal calls we can't size from outside, so the study states 16.2 with that caveat attached rather than implying a half week from question to live page. The impact figure is modeled, no call-volume data exists, so the claim is that each missing policy is a call that did not need to happen, not a counted number of calls.

recommended_pick.name: Arrival Notice Desk (deterministic workflow, one conditional extraction node), piloted at Bethel
recommended_pick.why_it_survives: It survives because it is barely an AI build, and that is the correct answer rather than a weakness. Every step a shipper ever sees is deterministic and testable: a set diff that finds what newly arrived, a date computed under a rule the company itself published, a fixed template, and a release action by a person who handled the freight that day. It rides a process the station is already required to run daily, so it needs no new integration and no vendor permission, which is what separates it from the better-looking event engine that rests on Takeflite access nobody has verified. It is the only job on the map where the company's own tariff creates the obligation rather than a customer creating a request, so value lands whether or not a single shipper changes behavior, and the artifact it produces, a timestamped written notice, is simultaneously the service, the cost reduction and the evidentiary record a storage fee already depends on. The anxiety force is retired by construction rather than by reassurance: no model sentence reaches a customer, no rate or policy is stated in free text, a human confirms before anything sends, and nothing is autonomous, so the compounding-error math never gets the chance to run.

where_not_to_use_ai: Nothing a shipper reads in the Arrival Notice Desk is written by a model. Finding what newly arrived is a diff, the storage date is arithmetic on a rule Ryan Air already publishes, matching a consignee is deterministic fuzzy matching with a human queue below the threshold, and the notice itself is a fixed template, all of which can be tested line by line in a way no model can. The only place a model is even considered is reading a paper reconciliation sheet, and that node drops out of scope entirely if the sheet turns out to be a Takeflite export, which is the outcome we are hoping for. We also decline the whole dispatch and weather lane, where VEIA-style tooling is real and relevant, because the cost of error is a human life and the human relay is the safety control.
honest_flags: The format of the daily on-hand reconciliation is unknown, and it decides whether this build contains any AI at all. If it is a Takeflite export, we delete the model and say so.

Consignee contact details are the gap that can block the whole build. If the contact data is not there, phase one is contact capture, a data project rather than an AI project, and that goes in the scope in plain words.
Takeflite API access is unverified and the vendor grants it, not Ryan Air. That is why the pick avoids needing it.

No volume, call-count, cycle-time or error-rate baseline exists for this company. Every figure is a modeled illustration, not a measurement, and the shipment poundage figure is on the DO_NOT_USE list so no volume claim may appear anywhere.

The once-daily trigger CAPS call deflection, and we say it before a reader spots it. A reconciliation that closes at end of day protects the RECORD better than it protects the PHONE, so a customer whose freight lands at ten in the morning may still call at noon.
Human review degrades into rubber stamping. Override rate is tracked as a live metric, and a rate falling to zero is evidence the review became theatre, never evidence the system became perfect.
The 16.2 RICE on the free policy work is publishing effort, not decision effort.

The Everts relationship changes the pilot site rather than the scope. The on-hand list at Aniak and Nome plausibly mixes carriers, so if the reconciliation does not distinguish carrier at all, those two stations are blocked until it does.

Saltchuk Aviation Shared Services may own this work, and sibling Northern Air Cargo already runs the estimator we would otherwise pitch. MIT NANDA found buying from specialized vendors succeeded about twice as often as internal builds, so before selling anything we should ask whether Takeflite or a notification vendor already sells it. Saying that costs us work and it is true.
The bypass mail order lookup may be a vendor configuration rather than a build. Tell them to open a ticket first, and if it is a setting nobody should be paid for it, including us.

Hold the tone at gaps a busy carrier has while its rates team ships every month, never at neglect, because nine customer-facing pages changed in the last six weeks and the prospect owns the sitemap that proves it.
